page.overview:
Who is Anniversary Singer?

The Anniversary Singer is a professional singer who works in Springfield. He makes his first and only appearance in "Simpson and Delilah."

Knowing Homer would forget his and Marge's wedding anniversary, Karl hired him to give Marge flowers and a box of chocolates, before singing "You Are So Beautiful To Me". After the song was over, Marge told Homer she loved him, and he told her he loved her too, and accidentally called her "Karl," and they hugged.
